svg.title: Lead Generation RAG System: Finding sales leads from public social-media posts instead of paying for ads.

g.text: Finding sales leads from public social-media posts instead of
Social-media scrapers collect public posts; the text is
cleaned and embedded with a multilingual model (Arabic and
English) into a ChromaDB vector store, and people and
entities are linked in a Neo4j graph.
